blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Authorities have taken into police custody the prime suspect in the killing of a nursing student who was found dead at a vacant lot in Calapan City over the weekend, officials confirmed on Monday. The suspect was initially identified as a 26-year-old church pastor, who voluntarily surrendered to responding officers along Legarda Street in Quiapo, Manila, early Monday, Police Colonel Gerry Laylo, Police Regional Intelligence Division Chief, said. But a senior church official said the man, who was detained in connection with the killing of a 20-year-old nursing student, is not an ordained pastor of the Church […]...
